material_findings.title: Cosmos Stack Immunefi bounty is live with a $50,000 maximum and cryptography/protocol scope
material_findings.summary: Immunefi currently lists the Cosmos bug-bounty program as live, last updated Sep. 17, 2026, with a $50,000 maximum. Blockchain/DLT rewards are $50,000 critical, $4,000 high, $1,000 medium, and $500 low under Primacy of Rules. The program specifically targets the Cosmos Stack's distributed-systems protocols, cryptography, smart-contract platform, consensus and interoperability components; it says ordinary web-application findings such as XSS, CSRF and header misconfiguration are not the program focus. PoC and KYC are required, and responsible publication requires approval.
material_findings.recommended_action: When chronology reaches this contribution, reopen the information/scope/resources pages, preserve exact target revisions and in-scope impacts/exclusions, verify researcher eligibility and acceptance of KYC/disclosure terms, then create a structured authorized bounty case only if participation is intended. Restrict all work to the exact published program scope and preferably local/source-code reproduction where the rules permit it.
